quest.title: The Festering Fang
quest.description: You picked up a strange "Dragontooth" while adventuring in Dragonspine. Perhaps you should ask around and see if someone knows anything more about it...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Unknown Item #13409 x1, Diagram: Dragonspine Spear x1

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Ah, I was hoping you'd swing by. Yes, about those Dragonteeth... Oh, I see you've already finished gathering them up.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: When you were off exploring, I ended up hitting a slight snag over here... No matter what I hit this Dragontooth with, I simply cannot take so much as a sliver off of it.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: I've never seen anything like this before, so I had someone talk to Mr. Albedo to see how we should deal with these materials.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: And so, if you look over yonder, you'll see that Mr. Albedo had Miss Sucrose send over a Runestone. It's right on the Alchemist's Crafting Bench.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Runestone? What's that got to do with our Dragonteeth?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Well, according to what Miss Sucrose relayed to us from Mr. Albedo, we need to give the material some special treatment before we can use it to forge weapons.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: One of said methods is to have one Dragontooth absorb dragon-related "vitality," then used the vitalized Dragontooth to treat other Dragonteeth.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: As for what Miss Sucrose said about the Runestone... Ah, yes, she said it was "a relic left to the Knights of Favonius by a wandering troupe that helped Mondstadt rebel against the old nobility a thousand years ago."

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: The flautist of that troupe once fought against a monster known as "Bakunawa" in the Mare Jivari. This Runestone was carved from its body...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Wait a sec, if Paimon's memory isn't failing her, didn't Citlali tell us that the Mare Jivari was created by Sanhaj's battle with the Abyss... five hundred years ago?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are we sure the troupe's story is from a thousand years back?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Haha, how could it be mistaken? That wandering troupe's story of heroism has long since been recorded in the "History of Kings and Clans."

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Anyway, Mr. Albedo said that this Runestone contains "infinite vitality," similar to that of a dragon.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: All you need to do is use the Crafting Bench to absorb the vitality of the Runestone with the Dragontooth, then we can get to forging our weapons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds impressive... as expected of Albedo...

choices.text: We'll have to thank him later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah! If not for him, we'd be totally stuck... Anyway, {NICKNAME}, let's try absorbing the Runestone's power!

response.speaker: Orban
response.text: Haha, that's great! Here — you take this Dragontooth, and I'll leave that whole side of things to you.

response.speaker: Orban
response.text: Alchemy's truly something else, huh... How does one even absorb "vitality" from a thousand year-old stone?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: There, it's done! Haha! Here, hold that. How does it feel?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: How much do I owe you?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry about paying for it. The chance to work with these materials was a rare pleasure. No need to bring Mora into it.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Alright. I'd say this weapon is ready for an adventure, wouldn't you? I hope you'll take good care of it.

talks.objective: Obtain a Dragontooth that has absorbed power

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About these Dragonteeth...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: You're back! How'd it go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't even get around to absorbing the "vitality"...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Orban about what happened before...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: I never expected something like that to happen... *sigh* I'm just glad you're safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... You won't be able to use any Dragonteeth in your forging like this...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Don't worry. It's no skin off our backs.

dialogues.speaker: Alchemist's Crafting Bench
dialogues.text: (The Runestone on the Crafting Bench emits a strange glow...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Place the Dragontooth

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Orban starts forging the weapon...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler, how'd it go? Did you let your Dragontooth absorb vitality from <color=#00E1FFFF>the Crafting Bench over there</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: This luster, this texture... Hoho, this is it!

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Hahaha! I never knew alchemy could work such miracles. That's Mr. Albedo for you!

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. I can't work any alchemy to save my life. Right, now that we've got all the materials we need, give me a moment or two, and I'll get this weapon made right away...
